items.markdown:
Empanada machines `range from simple $2 manual handheld presses to $480+ automated commercial makers` , depending on your kitchen or business needs.

### Manual & Handheld Presses

- **[IMUSA Jumbo Empanada Maker Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462823130126382,imageDocid:1163507317274482472,gpcid:2350759467682736583,headlineOfferDocid:17297069971116598546,catalogid:17791692320348467889,productDocid:4977112259482655144,rds:PC_2350759467682736583%7CPROD_PC_2350759467682736583&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj9jpz33fuWAxWOUaQEHdaQM-YQxa4PegoIAggACAAIBhAL)** : A basic plastic mold that cuts, folds, and seals dough manually; prices range from $1 to $4 on [Goodman's](https://www.goodmans.net/i/7585/imusa-imu-71006w-jumbo-black-empanada-maker.htm?refs=google-shopping&reft=i_7585&srsltid=AU7gw4WVHpe-RRCYoiz1CaoSm3Cf6idUBri57sXn6KUhEdYJ5HF5mMHFS2I).
- **Handheld Plastic/Cast Iron Presses** : Tools like the [Amazon Empanada Maker](https://www.amazon.com/empanada-maker/s?k=empanada+maker) sets or tortilla presses cost between $10 and $35 for home baking.

### Electric & Rechargeable Gadgets

- **Electric Dumpling & Empanada Maker** : A cordless, rechargeable kitchen gadget that automatically presses and seals two pockets at once for about $35.

### Commercial & Industrial Machines

- **Semi-Automated & High-Capacity Lines** : Industrial solutions like the [[ANKO Empanada Making Machine Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:8950190367551444724,headlineOfferDocid:11698924571345049051,productDocid:11698924571345049051&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj9jpz33fuWAxWOUaQEHdaQM-YQxa4PegoIAggACAAICBAC) ](https://www.anko.com.tw/en/food/Empanada.html) or [Empanadas Machine](https://www.empanadasmachine.com/) range from compact tabletop units to full production lines making up to 3,000 pieces per hour.
